metadata.title: KESTREL Security Controls Traceability Matrix
metadata.remarks: Notional. KESTREL is fictional, and NIST's High and privacy baselines stand in for its CNSSI 1253 selection. Generated by tools/sctm/build.py.

system-characteristics.description: An unmanned aircraft ISR system with IL5 cloud, on-premises, and fleet segments.

information-types.title: Source code, infrastructure as code, and pipeline definitions
Command link and root signing key material
Fleet and ground equipment maintenance records

authorization-boundary.description: The IL5 cloud hub and spokes, the mission data center, the alternate site, the IT/OT DMZ, and the UAS fleet and ground segment, as the System Description draws them.

components.title: KESTREL
components.description: KESTREL's own implementation, as the SADD and SIP define it.

components.title: Azure Government
